collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.before: The winner of a friendly canoe race reaches
ledger.after: (Name1), the winner of a friendly canoe race, reaches
ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: The winner of a friendly canoe race reaches the beach first while one canoe still struggles far behind with a cracked paddle.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), the winner of a friendly canoe race, reaches the beach first while one canoe still struggles far behind with a cracked paddle.

choices.label: Paddle Back Out to Accompany Them.
Share the Praise with the Other Racers.
Lend the Winning Paddle for the Next Race.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The two canoes come in side by side, and the crowd cheers for both.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The last paddler would rather finish alone, and the winner turns around and waits on the sand instead.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The winner names each paddler's best moment, and the celebration feels like everyone's.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The crowd still wants to hear only about the winner, who keeps steering the talk elsewhere.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The paddler with the cracked one finishes second, and both laugh about it afterward.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The paddle does not suit the borrower's grip, and they agree a race is a race.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The repair holds, and the owner says it is now their favorite paddle.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The crack runs too deep, and they carve a new blade together over the following days.
